name: SerpApi Search
description: Web search provider backed by SerpApi (Google Light, with 100+ engines). Specialized SerpApi tools follow in subsequent releases.

webSearch.apiKey.label: SerpApi API Key
webSearch.apiKey.help: SerpApi API key for all search engines (fallback: SERPAPI_API_KEY env var).

webSearch.hl.label: Default Language
webSearch.hl.help: Default language code for all searches (e.g. en, de, uk). Defaults to en.

hl.description: Default language code for all searches (e.g. en, de, ja). Defaults to en.
